About MindzSpark

MindzSpark is an independent MHT-CET counselling service for Maharashtra engineering admissions. Every preference list is generated from your percentile, rank, and preferences, then reviewed and finalized by a real counsellor before delivery — you never receive a raw algorithm output.

MindzSpark is not affiliated with the State CET Cell, Maharashtra, or DTE. Official CAP registration and option-form submission happen only on the official CET Cell portal.
